name: SGLang
qwen_support: First-class. Native qwen3, qwen3_coder, qwen3_5_moe architectures; GDN hybrid support; vision tower served live.
gotchas: DFlash2 merged upstream 2026-08-19, after every released image tag. No published Docker image has it; you must build from the patch tree.
YaRN / context >262144 leaks into the DSpark and DFlash2 draft configs and crashes the rope validator with AttributeError: max_position_embeddings. YaRN is MTP-only.
--enable-dp-attention and the overlap scheduler must be off in the DFlash2 path.
Tool calling needs no extra flag here, unlike vLLM's --enable-auto-tool-choice.
Stock --mamba-full-memory-ratio 0.9 over-provisions KV and clamps concurrency; pin 4.21 on GDN models.
If speculative decoding errors at boot, try --attention-backend triton.

methods.label: pip / uv (NVIDIA, CUDA 13)
methods.note: Needs Python 3.10+ and a CUDA 13 environment. SGLang 0.5.19 was the last release with a CUDA 12 lane.

methods.label: Docker (NVIDIA)

steps.text: Start the container with --gpus all, port 30000 and your Hugging Face cache mounted, as shown on the install page (it needs your own cache path).

methods.note: Needs Docker Engine, the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and a CUDA 13-compatible driver.
